Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You recognize the tremor and work quickly to ease what is spreading through their body.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing creature
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Recovery

Choose an eligible willing creature and roll Knowledge. Reduce its temporary Poisoned by the amount below, to a minimum of 0. This restores no HP. A persistent condition marked with an asterisk requires the treatment or remedy stated by its source.

Weak
Reduce Poisoned by 1.
Standard
Reduce Poisoned by 2.
Strong
Reduce Poisoned by 3.
